evidenceIsolation.policy: Restore Preview has its own implementation evidence and handoff. Shared historical family naming does not merge it with About.

retiredRouteDrift.policy: Removed from D2 INTEGRATION_MAP and fail-loud in render-runtime. Failed and partial are outcome states rendered by restore-result, not independent route/state owners.

r2aInstrumentation.identityPolicy: All 47 route/state occurrences use explicit scope, mode, conflict, preview, progress, cancel and result business keys. No ordinal, selector hash, label or DOM-position identity is accepted.

coveredFlows: scope toggle with at least-one guard
individual and batch local/remote conflict resolution
guards: duplicate execution resolves duplicate while a request is pending
completion requires the current requestId and requestEpoch
cancel increments requestEpoch and later completion resolves stale
failed/partial remain outcomes of the canonical result owner

ariaAndFocus.scopeControls: native buttons expose aria-pressed; nested visual switches expose role=switch, aria-checked and business identity
ariaAndFocus.conflicts: six individual local/remote controls plus two batch controls have independent business identities
ariaAndFocus.commitDialog: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby and deterministic data-dialog-initial-focus
ariaAndFocus.loading: submitting/result controls expose aria-busy and disabled while cancel remains reachable
ariaAndFocus.failed: restore-result failed outcome exposes role=alert and aria-invalid
ariaAndFocus.partial: partial outcome keeps accessible result actions

figmaReadOnlyBaseline.knownStructuralGap: The responsive master subtree was read as INSTANCE=0 during F0 preparation. The serial writer must use real canonical component instances and preserve downstream instances/reactions.

figmaDecisionsRequired: Update shared scope selector, mode selector, conflict pair, dialog, progress and result-state components before page masters.
Maintain clear local/remote comparison and right-align trailing choices/actions.
Represent success/failed/partial as traceable states of the canonical result component; do not recreate retired routes as detached pages.
Repair Phone and Tablet masters only. Landscape inherits Tablet; Compact/Fold structures are prohibited.
Repair Page 24 masters through real component instances, then let Page 23 instances inherit; screenshots and detached frames are prohibited.
Preserve reactions and downstream instances. Figma may not change UiEvent, state owner, async guards or restore business flow.
